name: Hasantha Malavipathirana
bio: I'm a 3rd year undergraduate at University of Moratuwa, Sri Lanka and currently an intern at augmented senses group, SUTD. I'm studying Electronic and Telecommunication Engineering.

publications.title: Feel & See the Globe: A Thermal, Interactive Installation
publications.citation: Huber, J., Malavipathirana, H., Wang, Y., Li, X., Fu, J.C., Maes, P. and Nanayakkara, S.C., 2015, March. Feel & see the globe: a thermal, interactive installation. In Proceedings of the 6th Augmented Human International Conference (pp. 215-216).
